text_blocks.snippet: The 2009 H1N1 influenza pandemic, commonly known as swine flu, occurred from April 2009 to August 2010.
The first cases were identified in Mexico in April 2009, and the virus quickly spread worldwide. The pandemic resulted in an estimated 1.4 billion infections and 18,449 deaths globally.
